review_notes: I read the whole file. Its definitions are `generatorCodomain`, `generator`, `definingIdeal`, `coordinateHopfAlgebra`, `restriction` and `carrierDefiningIdeal`. Each is a specialisation of the project's own `CommHopfAlgCat` common-kernel and quotient API to the E₇ positive subgroup. They are not independent competing versions of a Mathlib concept. A grep of Mathlib's Hopf-related files for `commonKernelHopfIdeal` and `def quotient` found nothing. Mathlib has no `CommHopfAlgCat`, no `HopfIdeal` common-kernel construction, and no smooth or geometrically connected Hopf-algebra properties, so there is nothing to integrate with. I did not inspect the project's generated-carrier files in detail. The repeated `match j with ...` blocks are a local style issue, outside this rubric.
